questions.question: 1. An object executes simple harmonic motion with an amplitude A. At which position (i) its speed becomes half of its maximum speed? (ii) its potential energy becomes half of its total energy?

questions.subject: Physics (Written)(4)
questions.question: 2. A meter scale of mass $m$ is moving uniformly with speed $v$ in the direction of its length. Its relativistic length is $60 \mathrm{~cm}$ and relativistic momentum is $8 \mathrm{Joule} / \mathrm{c}$, (where $c=$ speed of light in free space.) What is the value of its relativistic energy?

questions.question: 3. According to the kinetic theory of gases, the pressure of an ideal gas is given by $\mathbf{P}=\frac{\rho v^{2}}{3}$, where $\rho$ is the density of gas and $v^{2}$ is the mean square speed of the molecules. Show that, the average kinetic energy of the molecules, $E=\frac{3}{2} k T$.

questions.subject: English (Written)(2)
questions.question:
1. Read the following extract and answer the question below.
Blow, blow, thou winter wind,
Thou art not so unkind
As man's ingratitude;
Thy tooth is not so keen,
Because thou art not seen,
Although thy breath be rude.
Heigh-ho! sing, heigh-ho! unto the green holly:
Most friendship is feigning, most loving mere folly:
Then, heigh-ho, the holly!
This life is most jolly.
Compare and contrast nature and mankind as presented in the given extract.
